name: Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket: Pulsing Aura
summary: Get ready for battle with new Pokémon and Supporter cards debuting in Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket! The latest expansion, Pulsing Aura, is now available in Pokémon TCG Pocket. Dive into the debut of Mega Lucario ex, Mega Sceptile ex, and a variety of Pokémon known to train hard for the crucial moments of battle. Korrina and Arena of Antiquity are here to aid some of these Pokémon and give you the upper hand!
